abstract: [Circulation] Electrocardiographic analysis aided by artificial intelligence (AI) may identify atrial electrical vulnerability during sinus rhythm. The objective of this study was to determine whether AI-enabled ECG (AI-ECG) is effective for detecting atrial fibrillation (AF), atrial flutter (AFl), or prespecified pre-AF atrial findings in a randomized trial. In this single-center, open-label trial, 14 665 adults 40 to 85 years of age without previous AF/AFl were randomized to an AI-ECG-guided strategy or usual care. Participants randomized to AI-ECG who were then identified by AI as having a high-risk sinus-rhythm ECG in the preceding year were offered Holter monitoring for ≤7 days. Each monitored high-risk intervention participant was paired with an age- and sex-matched control selected before control ECGs underwent AI analysis. Matched controls received identical monitoring to reduce ascertainment bias. Reporting cardiologists were blinded to AI results and randomized assignment. The primary outcome was a composite of newly detected AF, AFl, or pre-AF atrial findings within 90 days. Pre-AF atrial findings comprised frequent premature atrial complexes, short runs of premature atrial complexes, or nonsustained AF/AFl. Among 7337 intervention and 7328 control participants, 84 (1.1%) and 78 (1.1%), respectively, were classified as high risk. Of the 84 high-risk intervention participants, 48 (57.1%) underwent monitoring, as did 48 matched controls. title: Large language models are unstable as autonomous medical evaluators across clinical tasks.
source: PubMed · Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA

abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as automated evaluators of medical text ("LLM-as-judge"). We tested whether LLM-evaluator performance validated on one medical task against a human reference standard remains stable on a structurally different task. We evaluated 10 LLMs (3 locally served open-source and 7 API models: Claude, GPT, DeepSeek) as autonomous judges on 3 tasks with human reference labels: LiveQA-Med answer quality (n = 300), PubMedQA research appraisal (n = 300), and Emergency Severity Index (ESI) triage on MIMIC-IV-Ext (n = 256). Each case was scored 3 times per model at temperature zero (25 680 judgments). Analyses used cluster-bootstrap confidence intervals, quadratic-weighted Cohen's κ, and false-discovery-rate correction. Evaluator performance was unstable across tasks: no model ranked in the top 3 on all 3 tasks, and every model shifted by 3 or more rank positions between at least one pair of tasks. In the highest-stakes task, ESI level 1 (Resuscitation) cases were under-triaged in 89.1% of evaluations, in all 10 models (range 70.2%-96.9%). Best triage agreement only reached the human inter-rater range (Claude Opus quadratic-weighted κ = 0.60 [0.54, 0.66]). Locally served 7-27B models (no per-query charge) occupied the Pareto frontier on the text tasks but only its low-concordance end on triage. LLM-evaluator performance is unstable between medical tasks that differ in cognitive structure; performance validated on one task should not be assumed to transfer to another. Task-specific validation against human reference labels is required before deployment, and emergency triage demands human oversight at the highest-acuity tier.
zh_abstract: [美国医学信息学会杂志（JAMIA）] 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用作医学文本的自动评估者（“LLM 作为评判者”）。我们检验了在某一医学任务上对照人工参考标准验证过的 LLM 评估者表现，在结构不同的另一任务上是否仍保持稳定。我们评估了 10 个 LLM（3 个本地部署的开源模型和 7 个 API 模型：Claude、GPT、DeepSeek），让其在 3 项带有人工参考标签的任务上作为自主评判者：LiveQA-Med 答案质量（n = 300）、PubMedQA 研究评价（n = 300），以及 MIMIC-IV-Ext 上的急诊严重度指数（ESI）分诊（n = 256）。每个病例在每个模型上于温度为零的条件下评分 3 次（共 25 680 次判断）。分析采用整群自助法（cluster-bootstrap）置信区间、二次加权 Cohen κ 以及错误发现率校正。评估者表现在不同任务间并不稳定：没有任何模型在全部 3 项任务中都位列前 3，且每个模型至少在一对任务之间的排名变化达到 3 位或以上。在风险最高的任务中，ESI 1 级（复苏）病例在 89.1% 的评估中被分诊不足，且 10 个模型均如此（范围 70.2%–96.9%）。最佳分诊一致性仅达到人类评估者间一致性的范围（Claude Opus 二次加权 κ = 0.60 [0.54, 0.66]）。本地部署的 7–27B 模型（无按查询计费）在文本任务上位于帕累托前沿，但在分诊任务中仅处于其低一致性一端。在认知结构不同的医学任务之间，LLM 评估者的表现并不稳定；不应假定在某一任务上验证的表现可迁移到另一任务。部署前需要针对人工参考标签进行任务特异性验证，并且急诊分诊在最高急症级别需要人工监督。

summary: 研究在控制人口学混杂后，用耦合Mamba融合多导睡眠图各模态，评估其对长期心血管风险的预后信息，并在SHHS数据集上验证。

abstract: Abstract Long-term cardiovascular disease (CVD) risk prediction remains a major global clinical priority. This study investigates how much prognostic information full-night polysomnography (PSG) carries after explicitly controlling demographic confounding, and whether combining specialized unimodal representations with continuous fusion mechanisms can effectively leverage it. We adopt a modular framework based on Coupled Mamba for simultaneous cross-modal and temporal fusion, capturing long-range dependencies and dynamic interactions between physiological modalities throughout sleep. With this capability we assess whether specialized supervised representations from task-specific unimodal encoders offer prognostic value comparable to task-agnostic multimodal self-supervised pre-training. Validated on the Sleep Heart Health Study (SHHS) dataset, our approach achieves performance comparable to or better than current state-of-the-art architectures in the fully supervised, data-abundant regime, although the cardiac channel alone accounts for most of the discriminative signal. More importantly, we identify a significant age-related bias in the reference dataset that, if left unaddressed, creates a shortcut leading to inflated risk predictions, accounting for a large part of the literature’s reported performance. Ultimately, our findings suggest that supervised unimodal experts integrated through a fusion engine provide a flexible pathway for prognostic risk ranking from sleep recordings, while reliable CVD screening will require independent external cohorts and explicit confounder control.
zh_abstract: 摘要 长期心血管疾病（CVD）风险预测仍是全球临床的重要优先事项。本研究探讨在明确控制人口统计学混杂因素之后，整夜多导睡眠图（PSG）携带了多少预后信息，以及将专门化的单模态表征与连续融合机制相结合能否有效利用这些信息。我们采用基于耦合 Mamba（Coupled Mamba）的模块化框架，同时进行跨模态和时间维度的融合，以捕捉整个睡眠过程中生理模态之间的长程依赖和动态相互作用。借助这一能力，我们评估了来自任务特异性单模态编码器的专门化监督表征，是否提供与任务无关的多模态自监督预训练相当的预后价值。在睡眠心脏健康研究（Sleep Heart Health Study，SHHS）数据集上验证，在完全监督、数据充足的条件下，我们的方法取得了与当前最先进架构相当或更优的性能，尽管仅心脏通道就贡献了大部分判别信号。更重要的是，我们在参考数据集中发现了显著的年龄相关偏倚；若不加以处理，该偏倚会形成捷径，导致风险预测被高估，并解释了文献中所报告性能的很大一部分。最终，我们的研究结果表明，通过融合引擎整合的监督式单模态专家模型，为基于睡眠记录的预后风险排序提供了一条灵活的途径，而可靠的 CVD 筛查则需要独立的外部队列和明确的混杂因素控制。

title: Personalized health coaching via coachable health age and counterfactual wearable trajectories
zh_title: 基于可指导健康年龄与反事实可穿戴轨迹的个性化健康指导
summary: 提出基于可穿戴信号的可指导健康年龄CHA，并在约10万人、220万人周数据上预训练动作条件传感器世界模型SensorWM。
key_points: CHA覆盖WEAR-ME、All of Us等队列
预测心血管与代谢疾病优于年龄性别BMI

reason: 预印本，大规模多队列，可穿戴世界模型，命中偏好
abstract: Personalized health coaching requires moving beyond retrospective wearable summaries toward quantitative, actionable behavioral prescriptions. We introduce Coachable Health Age (CHA), an interpretable health-age metric built from modifiable physiological and behavioral signals passively captured by consumer wearables. Across the WEAR-ME (N=2,780), All of Us (N=22,748), and longitudinal Fitbit (N=1,464) cohorts, CHA aligns with established cardiometabolic health constructs and improves prognostic discrimination for incident cardiovascular and metabolic disease beyond age, sex, and body mass index. To enable prospective behavioral optimization, we developed Sensor World Model (SensorWM), an action-conditioned wearable world model pretrained on over 2.2 million person-weeks of longitudinal sensor data from approximately 100,000 participants. SensorWM accurately forecasts multi-week physiological responses to candidate lifestyle changes ($R^2=0.664$), outperforming generic time-series foundation models while preserving downstream clinical signal for diabetes, hypertension, and other health outcomes. Finally, we integrate CHA and SensorWM into an agentic counterfactual coaching system to synthesize personalized 12-week coaching plans. In blinded paired reviews, certified lifestyle coaches preferred counterfactual-grounded plans over plans grounded in wearable history alone for overall quality (71.4%, P < 0.001) and anticipated adherence (71.0%, P < 0.001), and board-certified clinicians judged 99.2% of counterfactual-grounded plans to meet clinical safety criteria (vs. 97.6% of comparison plans). Automated evaluations across the full cohort (N=2,780) also favored counterfactual-grounded plans. By closing the loop between longitudinal tracking, trajectory prediction, and counterfactual coaching, our framework provides a scalable path to systematically improve cardiometabolic health.
zh_abstract: 个性化健康指导需要超越对可穿戴设备数据的回顾性总结，转向定量、可执行的行为处方。我们提出可指导健康年龄（Coachable Health Age，CHA），这是一种可解释的健康年龄指标，基于消费级可穿戴设备被动采集的可改变的生理和行为信号构建。在 WEAR-ME（N=2,780）、All of Us（N=22,748）和纵向 Fitbit（N=1,464）队列中，CHA 与既有的心脏代谢健康构念相一致，并且在年龄、性别和体重指数之外，进一步提高了对新发心血管和代谢疾病的预后区分能力。为实现前瞻性的行为优化，我们开发了传感器世界模型（Sensor World Model，SensorWM），这是一种以行动为条件的可穿戴世界模型，基于来自约100,000名参与者的超过220万人周的纵向传感器数据进行预训练。SensorWM 能准确预测候选生活方式改变后数周的生理反应（$R^2=0.664$），优于通用时间序列基础模型，同时保留了对糖尿病、高血压及其他健康结局的下游临床信号。最后，我们将 CHA 和 SensorWM 整合进一个智能体式反事实指导系统，以生成个性化的12周指导方案。在盲法配对评审中，认证生活方式教练在整体质量（71.4%，P < 0.001）和预期依从性（71.0%，P < 0.001）方面更偏好基于反事实的方案，而非仅基于可穿戴设备历史数据的方案；经委员会认证的临床医生判定99.2%的基于反事实的方案符合临床安全标准（对照方案为97.6%）。在全队列（N=2,780）上的自动评估同样更支持基于反事实的方案。通过打通纵向追踪、轨迹预测和反事实指导的闭环，我们的框架为系统性改善心脏代谢健康提供了一条可扩展的路径。

title: Multimodal AI in Oral Cancer: A PRISMA-Guided Systematic Review.
zh_title: 口腔癌多模态AI：PRISMA系统综述
summary: 系统综述纳入82余项2015–2025年研究，结果显示多模态模型在诊断准确率、AUC和生存预测上总体优于单模态。
key_points: 整合组织病理、影像、基因组与临床数据
涉及CNN、Transformer、图神经网络
注意力、图嵌入和融合Transformer表现较优
reason: 系统综述、纳入研究较多，命中多模态与肿瘤偏好；综述上限
abstract: [Healthcare technology letters] Oral cancer presents significant diagnostic and prognostic challenges, often due to late-stage detection and tumour heterogeneity. Recent advancements in artificial intelligence (AI), particularly deep learning (DL) and machine learning (ML), offer promising solutions by integrating multimodal biomedical data. This PRISMA-guided systematic review evaluates over 82 studies from 2015 to 2025 that apply convolutional neural networks, transformers and graph neural networks to oral cancer, using combinations of histopathology, radiology, genomics and clinical data. Results indicate that multimodal AI models consistently outperform unimodal approaches in diagnostic accuracy, AUC and survival prediction. Architectures employing attention mechanisms, graph embedding and fusion transformers demonstrate superior performance in tasks such as early lesion detection and treatment outcome modelling. Despite these advances, challenges persist in generalisability, data standardisation and clinical validation. Multimodal AI thus represents a paradigm shift toward precision oncology in oral cancer, warranting further research focused on interpretability, prospective validation and ethical clinical deployment.
zh_abstract: [Healthcare technology letters] 口腔癌在诊断和预后方面面临重大挑战，这通常源于确诊时已属晚期以及肿瘤异质性。人工智能（AI），尤其是深度学习（DL）和机器学习（ML）的最新进展，通过整合多模态生物医学数据提供了有前景的解决方案。本项遵循PRISMA指南的系统综述评价了2015年至2025年间82项以上的研究，这些研究将卷积神经网络、Transformer和图神经网络应用于口腔癌，并结合了组织病理学、放射学、基因组学和临床数据。结果表明，多模态AI模型在诊断准确性、AUC和生存预测方面始终优于单模态方法。采用注意力机制、图嵌入和融合Transformer的架构在早期病变检测和治疗结局建模等任务中表现更佳。尽管取得了这些进展，但在泛化能力、数据标准化和临床验证方面仍存在挑战。因此，多模态AI代表了口腔癌精准肿瘤学的范式转变，值得围绕可解释性、前瞻性验证和符合伦理的临床部署开展进一步研究。

title: Accuracy and reliability of privacy-compliant large language models for MRI protocol selection in radiological workflows.
zh_title: 隐私合规大语言模型用于MRI协议选择的准确性与可靠性
summary: 回顾性评估四个开源权重LLM对1201份真实转诊单的MRI协议和序列选择，以两名放射科医师共识为参照。
key_points: 1201份连续转诊单
大型通用模型一致性最高
GPT-OSS-120B Jaccard 0.96，准确率0.94
reason: 同行评审回顾性研究，样本可观但单机构内部评估
abstract: [European radiology] Accurate MRI protocolling is essential for diagnostic quality and workflow efficiency, yet manual protocol selection is time-consuming and variable. This study evaluated four contemporary open-weight large language models (LLMs) for MRI protocol and optional sequence selection from real-world clinical referrals. In this retrospective study, 1201 consecutive referral forms (mean age 58 ± 14 years; 646 men) were provided as unaltered text to each LLM, which selected an institutional protocol and optional sequences from predefined lists. A consensus of two board-certified radiologists served as reference. Performance was assessed at protocol and sequence levels using protocol accuracy and mean Jaccard index. Larger general-purpose models achieved the highest concordance with expert protocolling (GPT-OSS-120B: Jaccard 0.96, 95% CI: 0.96-0.97; accuracy 0.94, 0.93-0.95; Qwen-3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507: Jaccard 0.96, 0.95-0.97; accuracy 0.94, 0.93-0.96), outperforming MedGemma-27B-Text-IT (Jaccard 0.85, 0.84-0.87; accuracy 0.79, 0.76-0.81) and Gemma-3-27B-IT (Jaccard 0.61, 0.59-0.63; accuracy 0.58, 0.55-0.60). Unacceptable protocol selections ranged from 70/1201 cases (5.8%) for GPT-OSS and 71/1201 (5.9%) for Qwen3 to 297/1201 (24.7%) for MedGemma and 820/1,201 (68.3%) for Gemma3. Among unacceptable cases, the most common error was anatomically correct but clinically suboptimal protocol selection (57.7-70.7%), followed by incorrect anatomical region (11.6-39.4%) and optional-sequence-only errors (2.8-30.2%). GPT-OSS matched expert scan duration (p = 0.18), Qwen3 was shorter (p = 0.002), and Gemma3 and MedGemma were longer (both p < 0.001). Open-weight LLMs showed high concordance with expert MRI protocolling and may support standardized protocol selection. However, clinically relevant errors persisted, underscoring the need for radiologist oversight. Question Can open-weight LLMs support accurate and standardized MRI protocol and sequence selection from clinical referrals compared with expert reference standards? Findings In 1201 referrals, LLMs achieved high concordance with expert MRI protocol selection (accuracy up to 0.94; mean Jaccard index up to 0.96), but unacceptable errors remained model-dependent and ranged from 5.8% to 68.3%. Clinical relevance Open-weight LLMs showed high agreement with expert MRI protocol decisions from clinical text and may support standardized, reliable, and scalable MRI protocolling while maintaining radiologist oversight.
zh_abstract: [European radiology] 准确的 MRI 方案制定对诊断质量和工作流程效率至关重要，但人工选择方案耗时且存在差异。本研究评估了四种当代开放权重大语言模型（LLMs）根据真实临床申请单进行 MRI 方案及可选序列选择的表现。在这项回顾性研究中，1201份连续的申请单（平均年龄58 ± 14岁；646名男性）以未经修改的文本形式提供给每个 LLM，由其从预设列表中选择机构方案和可选序列。以两位委员会认证放射科医师的共识作为参照。使用方案准确率和平均 Jaccard 指数在方案和序列层面评估性能。较大的通用模型与专家方案制定的一致性最高（GPT-OSS-120B：Jaccard 0.96，95% CI：0.96-0.97；准确率0.94，0.93-0.95；Qwen-3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507：Jaccard 0.96，0.95-0.97；准确率0.94，0.93-0.96），优于 MedGemma-27B-Text-IT（Jaccard 0.85，0.84-0.87；准确率0.79，0.76-0.81）和 Gemma-3-27B-IT（Jaccard 0.61，0.59-0.63；准确率0.58，0.55-0.60）。不可接受的方案选择占比：GPT-OSS 为70/1201例（5.8%），Qwen3 为71/1201例（5.9%），MedGemma 为297/1201例（24.7%），Gemma3 为820/1,201例（68.3%）。在不可接受的病例中，最常见的错误是解剖部位正确但临床上次优的方案选择（57.7-70.7%），其次是解剖区域错误（11.6-39.4%）和仅可选序列错误（2.8-30.2%）。GPT-OSS 的扫描时长与专家相当（p = 0.18），Qwen3 更短（p = 0.002），Gemma3 和 MedGemma 更长（均 p < 0.001）。开放权重 LLMs 与专家 MRI 方案制定显示出高度一致性，可能有助于标准化方案选择。然而，仍存在具有临床意义的错误，突显了放射科医师监督的必要性。问题：与专家参照标准相比，开放权重 LLMs 能否支持根据临床申请单准确且标准化地选择 MRI 方案和序列？发现：在1201份申请单中，LLMs 与专家 MRI 方案选择的一致性较高（准确率最高0.94；平均 Jaccard 指数最高0.96），但不可接受错误仍取决于模型，范围为5.8%至68.3%。临床意义：开放权重 LLMs 根据临床文本做出的 MRI 方案决策与专家高度一致，在保持放射科医师监督的前提下，可能支持标准化、可靠且可扩展的 MRI 方案制定。

summary: 综述2020年以来120篇论文，按应用归类，涵盖图像合成、分割等任务，并讨论技术与临床挑战及未来方向。

abstract: [Journal of medical imaging (Bellingham, Wash.)] We aim to present a consolidated overview of current achievements in generative artificial intelligence (AI) in breast imaging, identify prevalent technical and clinical challenges alongside the strategies employed to overcome them, and highlight critical directions for future investigation. A comprehensive literature search has been conducted in PubMed, MEDLINE, and Embase for peer-reviewed journal publications since 2020, with the final search performed in October 2025. The review focuses on common methodologies, performance metrics, and strategies used to address existing hurdles in breast imaging. The 120 included papers were categorized by application, ranging from technical and/or clinical tasks-image synthesis (including 24 data augmentation, 10 enhancement, 20 image-to-image translation, and 2 secure data sharing papers), 12 segmentation, 5 reconstruction, and 16 classification papers-as well as 17 papers in radiology workflow improvement, 13 papers in the development of medical education materials, and 7 papers on solving beyond our defined tasks (six papers were assigned more than one application). Papers in each category showed their own potential to solve the task of interests. However, we identified six common challenges and concerns, such as lack of standardized evaluation for synthetic outputs, across papers that the future research should be focused on. Recent works across the field of generative AI in breast imaging have demonstrated transformative potential in clinical workflows. However, there still exists technical and ethical gaps to be addressed for safe, reliable, and equitable deployment of the generative AI models to routine medical practice.

abstract: [Journal of medical Internet research] Frontline health workers in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) often face barriers that compromise care quality, including limited training, high patient loads, inadequate access to updated clinical guidance, and resource constraints. Working in underserved settings further exacerbates challenges to providing accurate, complete, and empathetic responses. Addressing these gaps requires innovative tools to support FLWs in real time. This study aims to evaluate the effectiveness of ChatGPT-3.5 (OpenAI) in enhancing the quality of FLWs' responses to health inquiries in Lagos, Nigeria. In this observational study, 36 licensed frontline health workers (doctors, nurses, and community health workers) practicing general or primary care in Lagos, Nigeria, generated responses to 15 patient-generated health questions covering maternal and neonatal health, family planning, and sexually transmitted infections. Each FLW produced responses using their own knowledge and available resources (human-only) and with ChatGPT-3.5 assistance (GPT-aided). A panel of 4 clinicians evaluated responses using a 5-point Likert scale for accuracy, empathy, contextualization, completeness, safety, and overall preference. In addition, 8 nonclinician health seekers assessed a subset of responses across 3 themes: Caring, Trust, and Ease of Understanding. Across 1080 responses from 36 frontline health workers, GPT-aided responses significantly outperformed human-only responses on all clinician-rated metrics (P<.001), with the largest gains observed in completeness, empathy, and overall preference, particularly among community health extension workers (CHEWs). Nonclinician evaluators also favored GPT-aided responses across all themes, with a strong preference for trust. This study provides empirical evidence that a large language model (ChatGPT-3.5) enhances the completeness, empathy, and perceived trust of responses by frontline health workers in Lagos, Nigeria. These findings underscore the potential of integrating ChatGPT-3.5 to strengthen health care delivery in resource-limited settings, highlighting the necessity for capacity building and further investigation into its safe, equitable, and effective implementation.

[医学互联网研究杂志] 低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs）的一线卫生工作者（FLWs）常面临影响照护质量的障碍，包括培训有限、患者负荷高、难以获得最新临床指导以及资源受限。在服务不足地区工作进一步加剧了提供准确、完整且富有同理心回应的难度。弥补这些差距需要能够实时支持 FLWs 的创新工具。本研究旨在评估 ChatGPT-3.5（OpenAI）在提高尼日利亚拉各斯 FLWs 对健康咨询回应质量方面的有效性。
【方法】在这项观察性研究中，36名在尼日利亚拉各斯从事全科或初级保健的持证一线卫生工作者（医生、护士和社区卫生工作者）针对15个由患者提出的健康问题生成回应，问题涵盖孕产妇和新生儿健康、计划生育和性传播感染。每位 FLW 分别凭自己的知识和可用资源（仅人工）以及在 ChatGPT-3.5 辅助下（GPT辅助）作答。由4名临床医生组成的小组使用5分 Likert 量表对回应的准确性、同理心、情境化、完整性、安全性和总体偏好进行评分。此外，8名非临床的寻求健康信息者围绕三个主题评估了部分回应：关怀、信任和易于理解。
【结果】在36名一线卫生工作者的1080条回应中，GPT辅助的回应在所有临床医生评定的指标上均显著优于仅人工回应（P<.001），其中完整性、同理心和总体偏好的提升最大，尤其是在社区卫生推广工作者（CHEWs）中。非临床评估者在所有主题上也更偏好 GPT 辅助的回应，其中对信任的偏好尤为强烈。
【结论】本研究提供了实证证据，表明大语言模型（ChatGPT-3.5）提升了尼日利亚拉各斯一线卫生工作者回应的完整性、同理心和感知信任。这些发现凸显了整合 ChatGPT-3.5 以加强资源有限地区医疗服务的潜力，并强调需要开展能力建设，以及对其安全、公平和有效实施进行进一步研究。

abstract: [ChemMedChem] Over the past decade, artificial intelligence (AI) has increasingly influenced the early stages of drug discovery, which focus primarily on target evaluation and the design or identification of new active small molecules or biologics. Deep neural networks adapted from areas such as natural language processing and computer vision have provided novel opportunities for generative modeling and human-machine interactions. State-of-the-art AI models for generative molecular design have emerged, but remain only little understood so far. Furthermore, new computational systems are being devised rapidly that are expected to significantly transform the drug discovery landscape in the near future. These developments pose challenges to computer-aided drug discovery in various ways. In the following, we discuss these opportunities and challenges, with a focus on molecular design.

abstract: [European radiology] To compare the spatial overlap, imaging marker agreement, and outcome associations of acute ischemic regions of interest (ROIs) using deep-learning NCCT (DLNCCT) versus manual NCCT, CTP, and DWI-based segmentations. We trained a deep learning model to segment ischemic ROIs on admission NCCT (DLNCCT). DLNCCT was compared with manual NCCT, CTP (rCBF < 30%/38%), and DWI using the Dice similarity coefficient (mean ± SD), Bland-Altman analysis (mean difference [95% CI]), and concordance correlation coefficient (CCC). For each ROI, we compared NCCT imaging biomarkers: average lesion density (HU); modified net water uptake (mNWU in %); total volume (mL); and hypodense (≤ 26 HU) volume (mL). DLNCCT biomarkers were associated with reversed 90-day ordinal modified Rankin Scale (genOR [95% CI]). We used 218/762 train/test cases. Dice was 0.30 ± 0.30 between DLNCCT and manual segmentation, 0.22 ± 0.25 between DLNCCT-DWI, and 0.15 ± 0.22/0.21 ± 0.24 between CTP (rCBF < 30%/< 38%)-DWI. DLNCCT-DWI biomarker agreement was -1 HU (95% CI: -7; 6) for average density (CCC: 0.71), 4.9% (95% CI: -7.0; 16.8) for mNWU (CCC: 0.35), -16 mL (95% CI: -108; 76) for total volume (CCC: 0.57), and -4 mL (95% CI: -31; 23) for hypodense lesion volume (CCC: 0.75). Average lesion density (1.11 [95% CI: 1.06; 1.16]) and hypodense volume (0.85 [95% CI: 0.72; 0.99]) were associated with 90-day mRS. Spatial and biomarker agreement between DLNCCT and DWI was suboptimal but comparable to CTP-DWI. Nevertheless, DLNCCT-derived average lesion density and hypodense volume were associated with functional outcomes. Question Deep-learning models segment ischemic tissue on NCCT, but their spatial overlap and accuracy of imaging biomarker assessment relative to DWI and CTP core remain unclear. Findings Deep-learning NCCT segmentation showed good agreement with DWI in measuring hypodense (≤ 26 HU) volumes (- 4 mL [95% CI: -31; 23]; CCC 0.75). Clinical relevance Despite limited spatial overlap, NCCT-derived deep learning biomarkers showed agreement comparable to DWI, with improved performance in patients with poor ASPECTS and collateral scores. Hypodense volume and average lesion density were associated with functional outcome.
zh_abstract: [European radiology] 比较基于深度学习的 NCCT（DLNCCT）与基于人工 NCCT、CTP 和 DWI 分割所得急性缺血感兴趣区（ROI）的空间重叠、影像标志物一致性及与结局的关联。我们训练了一个深度学习模型，在入院 NCCT 上分割缺血 ROI（DLNCCT）。使用 Dice 相似系数（均值±标准差）、Bland-Altman 分析（均值差 [95% CI]）和一致性相关系数（CCC），将 DLNCCT 与人工 NCCT、CTP（rCBF < 30%/38%）及 DWI 进行比较。对每个 ROI，我们比较了 NCCT 影像生物标志物：平均病灶密度（HU）；改良净水摄取（mNWU，%）；总体积（mL）；以及低密度（≤ 26 HU）体积（mL）。将 DLNCCT 生物标志物与反向的90天序贯改良 Rankin 量表（genOR [95% CI]）进行关联分析。我们使用了218/762例训练/测试病例。DLNCCT 与人工分割之间的 Dice 为0.30 ± 0.30，DLNCCT 与 DWI 之间为0.22 ± 0.25，CTP（rCBF < 30%/< 38%）与 DWI 之间为0.15 ± 0.22/0.21 ± 0.24。DLNCCT 与 DWI 的生物标志物一致性：平均密度为 -1 HU（95% CI：-7；6）（CCC：0.71），mNWU 为4.9%（95% CI：-7.0；16.8）（CCC：0.35），总体积为 -16 mL（95% CI：-108；76）（CCC：0.57），低密度病灶体积为 -4 mL（95% CI：-31；23）（CCC：0.75）。平均病灶密度（1.11 [95% CI：1.06；1.16]）和低密度体积（0.85 [95% CI：0.72；0.99]）与90天 mRS 相关。DLNCCT 与 DWI 之间的空间和生物标志物一致性欠佳，但与 CTP-DWI 相当。尽管如此，DLNCCT 得出的平均病灶密度和低密度体积与功能结局相关。问题：深度学习模型可在 NCCT 上分割缺血组织，但其相对于 DWI 和 CTP 核心区的空间重叠及影像生物标志物评估的准确性尚不明确。发现：深度学习 NCCT 分割在测量低密度（≤ 26 HU）体积方面与 DWI 显示出良好的一致性（-4 mL [95% CI：-31；23]；CCC 0.75）。临床意义：尽管空间重叠有限，但源自 NCCT 的深度学习生物标志物显示出与 DWI 相当的一致性，且在 ASPECTS 和侧支评分较差的患者中表现有所改善。低密度体积和平均病灶密度与功能结局相关。

title: The measure that matters: What medicine asks of artificial intelligence.
zh_title: 衡量何为重要：医学对人工智能的要求
summary: 立场论文指出医学AI评估指标与临床价值错位，并提出以生命为中心的评估框架。

abstract: [Artificial intelligence in medicine] Medical artificial intelligence (AI) is advancing at unprecedented speed, yet the dominant question in the field, how well does a model perform, diverges from what clinicians ask of it in practice. Did it help someone survive? In this Position Paper, we argue that a misalignment exists between how the AI community evaluates success and how clinicians define value. Even the strongest randomized trials of clinical large language models measure subspecialist preference rather than patient survival, and in a 2024 scoping review of 86 randomized trials of AI in clinical practice, only 17% had a primary endpoint related to patient symptoms or behavior. Surveys of clinicians point to a further dimension that no benchmark captures, the erosion of human connection between clinician and patient. We propose a life-centered evaluation framework built on five principles, namely outcome primacy, dynamic evaluation, clinician co-design, relational outcomes, and transparent failure publication. The measure that ultimately matters is whether a system keeps a patient out of the intensive care unit, prevents a resuscitation, or spares a family a preventable loss.
zh_abstract: [医学人工智能] 医学人工智能（AI）正以前所未有的速度发展，但该领域占主导地位的问题——模型表现如何——与临床医生在实践中对其提出的要求并不一致。它是否帮助某人存活？在这篇立场文件中，我们认为 AI 界评估成功的方式与临床医生界定价值的方式之间存在错位。即使是最有力的临床大语言模型随机试验，衡量的也是亚专科医生的偏好，而非患者的生存；在2024年一项对86项临床实践中 AI 随机试验的范围综述中，只有17%的试验其主要终点与患者症状或行为相关。对临床医生的调查还指出了任何基准都无法衡量的另一维度，即临床医生与患者之间人际联系的削弱。我们提出了一个以生命为中心的评估框架，包含五项原则，即结局优先、动态评估、临床医生共同设计、关系性结局以及透明发表失败结果。最终真正重要的衡量标准是：一个系统是否能让患者免于进入重症监护室、避免一次心肺复苏，或使一个家庭免于可预防的失去。

title: Glyph: An Interpretability Engine for AI-Driven Scientific Discovery in Clinical Data
zh_title: Glyph：临床数据AI科学发现的可解释性引擎
summary: 提出Glyph，用于解释在大规模临床数据上训练的基础模型的潜在嵌入，以支持疾病机制与早期标志物的科学发现。
key_points: 针对预定义表型限制发现范围的问题
关注基础模型潜在特征难以解释

abstract: Automated scientific discovery has the potential to advance understanding of disease mechanisms and accelerate identification of early disease markers. Manual data annotation is infeasible at population scale, motivating methods that automatically extract pre-defined phenotypes in multimodal and unstructured clinical data. Such pre-defined feature sets determine and limit which associations these approaches can discover. This limitation extends to agentic AI systems that use these tools to query population-scale data. In contrast, foundation models (FMs) trained on large volumes of clinical data can perform tasks beyond their training objectives. This suggests their latent embeddings may represent novel or unexplored features that could yield insights into disease mechanisms, yet such latent features remain difficult to interpret. To address this challenge, we introduce Glyph, an automated multistage framework that extracts features from multimodal and unstructured clinical data using FMs and sparse autoencoders, interprets them as coded clinical concepts, and evaluates their value for clinical scientific discovery. We applied Glyph to abdominal CT volumes, CT radiology reports and laboratory measurements from 41,628 patients across different institutions. We identified 397 predictive concepts supported by 4,463 Bonferroni-significant associations. Moreover, a majority of discovered associations were automatically reproducible in held-out cohorts across different sites. Glyph concepts provided complementary associations to literature-derived markers, leading to gains in predictive power. We envision that interpretability can extend beyond a mechanistic understanding of neural networks to connecting implicitly learned features with clinical knowledge and establishing their significance for patient outcomes. We release Glyph at https://github.com/StanfordMIMI/Glyph.
zh_abstract: 自动化科学发现有望增进对疾病机制的理解，并加速早期疾病标志物的识别。在人群规模上进行人工数据标注是不可行的，这促使人们研究能够在多模态和非结构化临床数据中自动提取预定义表型的方法。此类预定义特征集决定并限制了这些方法能够发现哪些关联。这一局限也延伸到使用这些工具查询人群规模数据的智能体（agentic）AI系统。相比之下，在大量临床数据上训练的基础模型（FM）能够执行超出其训练目标的任务。这提示其潜在嵌入可能代表新的或尚未探索的特征，有可能为疾病机制提供见解，但这类潜在特征仍难以解释。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了Glyph，这是一个自动化的多阶段框架：利用FM和稀疏自编码器从多模态和非结构化临床数据中提取特征，将其解释为编码的临床概念，并评估其在临床科学发现中的价值。我们将Glyph应用于来自不同机构的41,628名患者的腹部CT容积数据、CT放射学报告和实验室检测结果。我们识别出397个预测性概念，并得到4,463个经Bonferroni校正后显著的关联支持。此外，大多数发现的关联可在不同中心的留出队列中自动复现。Glyph概念提供了与文献来源标志物互补的关联，从而提升了预测能力。我们设想，可解释性可以超越对神经网络的机制性理解，延伸到将隐式学习到的特征与临床知识联系起来，并确立其对患者结局的意义。我们在 https://github.com/StanfordMIMI/Glyph 发布了Glyph。

title: Remembering Is Not Enough: Evaluating Timing and Omission in Longitudinal AI Mental Health Support

abstract: Evaluations of large language models (LLMs) for mental health support commonly focus on the clinical appropriateness of individual responses, potentially overlooking failures that emerge across extended interactions. As AI assistants accumulate memory of users' circumstances and prior disclosures, this raises an accountability question: Do AI chatbots provide appropriate support as users' needs evolve? We investigate by analyzing 14,256 longitudinal simulations grounded in donated chatbot histories from 22 users, examining how a memory-equipped assistant responds to suicidal ideation, self-harm, and anxiety crises across recovery trajectories and communication styles. We introduce the Context-Aware and Readiness-Evaluative (CARE) framework, developed with mental health professionals, to assess the timing and quality of advice, including omissions. Advice was less aligned with users' readiness after a crisis than in matched control stretches of the same conversation, largely because of premature recommendations, which were most common when recovery stalled. Revisiting a crisis reduced premature advice but not lagging advice, and users' communication style changed how often and when the assistant gave recommendations. Although explicitly unproductive advice was rare, the assistant frequently omitted clinician-expected support such as follow-up and planning for next steps. These findings show the limits of single response-level safety evaluation and the need to assess timing, omission, and consistency across users when holding AI systems accountable for longitudinal support.
zh_abstract: 对用于心理健康支持的大语言模型（LLM）的评估通常侧重于单条回复的临床适当性，可能忽视在长时间交互中出现的失败。随着 AI 助手不断积累对用户处境和既往披露内容的记忆，这就引出了一个问责问题：AI 聊天机器人能否在用户需求变化时提供恰当的支持？我们对 14,256 次纵向模拟进行了分析，这些模拟基于 22 名用户捐赠的聊天机器人历史记录，考察配备记忆的助手如何在不同康复轨迹和沟通风格下应对自杀意念、自伤和焦虑危机。我们提出了与心理健康专业人员共同开发的情境感知与准备度评估（Context-Aware and Readiness-Evaluative，CARE）框架，用于评估建议的时机和质量，包括遗漏。与同一对话中匹配的对照片段相比，危机之后的建议与用户准备度的契合度更低，主要原因是过早给出建议，这在康复停滞时最为常见。重提危机可减少过早的建议，但不能减少滞后的建议，而用户的沟通风格会改变助手给出建议的频率和时机。尽管明确无益的建议很少见，但助手经常遗漏临床医生所期望的支持，如随访和下一步计划。这些发现表明，仅在单条回复层面进行安全性评估存在局限，在对 AI 系统的长期支持进行问责时，需要评估其时机、遗漏以及在不同用户之间的一致性。

title: Guardrail Erosion in Domain Fine-Tuned Large Language Models: A Paired Audit of Knowledge-Centric Abstention in Biomedical LLMs
zh_title: 领域微调大模型的护栏侵蚀：生物医学LLM知识型拒答审计
summary: 对25个生物医学微调LLM与11个基础模型配对，在MedAbstain和ClinDet-Bench上审计知识型拒答，基础模型拒答率已偏低。
key_points: 审计25个微调模型对11个基础检查点
基础模型MedAbstain拒答中位数仅8.3%
聚焦知识型而非价值型拒答
reason: 预印本，大规模配对审计，涉医学LLM安全，属值得一看档
abstract: The number of domain fine-tuned models, particularly in the biomedical domain, is rapidly expanding. Fine-tuning promises high-performing models at a fraction of the cost of training a base model, but it can also produce unintended behavioral changes. Multiple studies have shown that safety guardrails can erode with fine-tuning, yet large-scale studies across model architectures, data mixtures, and fine-tuning methodologies remain limited. Where prior work in this space has studied value-centric refusal, this work focuses on knowledge-centric abstention. We audit 25 biomedical domain fine-tuned large language models against 11 paired base checkpoints on MedAbstain and ClinDet-Bench to evaluate the impact of fine-tuning on knowledge-centric abstention. We find that defined appropriate abstention measured by these benchmarks, already low in base models (median 8.3% on MedAbstain), falls further after fine-tuning (median 4.2%, decreasing in 21 of 25 pairs on MedAbstain), and that the magnitude and direction of change are heterogeneous across pairs. These results motivate fine-tuning methods that improve domain-specific capability while preserving appropriate caution.

title: VoluCompose: Constructing Compact Volumetric Visual Representations for Medical Image Understanding
zh_title: VoluCompose：面向医学影像理解的紧凑体数据视觉表示
summary: 提出免训练、模型无关的框架，用双曲token组合与注意力熵控制压缩3D医学影像视觉token，降低视觉语言模型开销。

Lorentz距离用于token分配与锚点选择
按视觉编码器注意力熵分配容量

abstract: Medical vision--language models can interpret volumetric images, but processing full volumes is costly because hundreds of slices produce long, redundant visual-token sequences. Existing compression methods often couple content selection with budget determination. We observe that neighboring slices share visual features and that attention concentration varies across visual encoders. We propose VoluCompose, a training-free, model-agnostic framework that separates what visual content to retain from how many tokens to allocate. Its hyperbolic token composition module groups contiguous slices into ordered support units and uses the Lorentz distance to account for feature magnitude and direction during token allocation, anchor selection, and refinement. Its capacity control module uses visual-encoder attention entropy to allocate more tokens when attention is more dispersed. We evaluate VoluCompose on two tasks across three datasets and four backbones. Across nine calibrated settings, VoluCompose attains the highest mean quality--retention hypervolume among the compared methods. It achieves a mean relative quality of 121.68\% against the uncompressed references while retaining 22.78% of visual tokens on average. Compression remains robust even at a 10% token budget. Across settings, the lowest ROUGE-L ratio to the uncompressed reference is 96.4\% for VoluCompose. The corresponding minima for the compression baselines range from 15.0% to 70.5%. Code is available at https://github.com/yezanting/VoluCompose.

title: Artificial intelligence in cardiovascular medicine: systematic review of randomized controlled trials.

abstract: [European heart journal. Digital health] Artificial intelligence (AI) holds considerable promise for improving cardiovascular care, but prior to widespread adoption, AI-powered tools require evaluation in randomized trials. We systematically reviewed the current evidence from randomized trials of AI tools in cardiovascular medicine. We conducted a systematic review of randomized trials comparing AI tools vs. standard care in cardiovascular medicine. PubMed, the Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials, Scopus, and the International Clinical Trials Registry Platform were searched from 1 January 2018, to 10 April 2026. Screening and full-text review were performed by three independent reviewers and risk of bias was assessed using the RoB 2 criteria. Of 11 151 identified records, 8599 remained after removal of duplicates. Following screening and full-text review, 25 trials met the eligibility criteria. These trials evaluated AI tools in acute cardiovascular care (n = 3), cardiac imaging (n = 6), decision support for medical therapy (n = 6), electrophysiology (n = 8), and interventional cardiology (n = 2). Nine trials were single-centre, and two were international. Seventeen trials (68%) reported positive results, defined by non-inferiority or superiority of the AI-based strategy. Overall risk of bias was rated as high or with some concerns in 84% of the included trials, and only 36% explicitly reported following the CONSORT-/SPIRIT-AI reporting guidelines. Evidence from randomized trials evaluating AI tools in cardiovascular medicine is limited, and most trials have a high risk of bias. Wider implementation of AI tools into practice requires robust, international, multi-centre randomized trials that evaluate patient-relevant outcomes, ensure external validity, and adhere to reporting guidelines. PROSPERO CRD420251019264.

title: Predictive Analytics and Workflow Automation to Reduce Administrative Burden and Clinician Burnout in United States Clinical Settings: A Systematic Review.

Although digital systems were implemented to improve quality, safety, and care coordination, expanded documentation requirements, inbox messaging, and regulatory reporting have increased clerical workload. Traditional interruptive clinical decision support tools may further increase cognitive demands through alert fatigue and workflow disruption. Health systems have increasingly adopted predictive analytics and workflow-integrated automation, including ambient artificial intelligence (AI) documentation, inbox prioritization, and audit log-based workflow monitoring. However, their effects on operational efficiency and clinician well-being remain uncertain. This review examined clinician-facing interventions in US clinical settings and their impact on documentation workload, operational efficiency, and burnout-related outcomes. title: The Transformation of Oncology Drug Development in China: Toward a New Phase of Innovation.
zh_title: 中国肿瘤药物研发转型：迈向创新新阶段

abstract: [Cancer discovery] China's oncology drug development ecosystem has shifted from rapid pipeline expansion toward clinical value-driven innovation. We review regulatory reform and the 2015 to 2025 evolution of clinical development across small molecules, mAbs, multispecific antibodies, antibody-drug conjugates, and cell and gene therapies. China's disease burden and enrollment capacity have enabled globally relevant advances in EGFR-mutant lung cancer, gastrointestinal malignancies, hepatocellular carcinoma, nasopharyngeal carcinoma, and CLDN18.2-directed therapies. We highlight persistent challenges in target and modality convergence, biomarker definition, therapeutic window optimization, manufacturing consistency, and globally interpretable evidence generation and discuss how artificial intelligence may connect target discovery, drug design, and clinical trial optimization more efficiently. China has become a major source of oncology trials and modality innovation, but scale alone will not ensure global impact. This review links regulatory reform, disease-specific opportunity, target biology, therapeutic format, and evidence quality across a decade of solid tumor development. It defines the conditions under which China-originated programs can generate globally practice-changing evidence. See related article by Shi, p. XX .
zh_abstract: [Cancer discovery] 中国的肿瘤药物研发生态已从管线的快速扩张转向以临床价值为导向的创新。我们回顾了监管改革以及 2015 年至 2025 年间小分子药物、单克隆抗体、多特异性抗体、抗体药物偶联物以及细胞和基因治疗的临床开发演变。中国的疾病负担和入组能力推动了在 EGFR 突变肺癌、胃肠道恶性肿瘤、肝细胞癌、鼻咽癌以及 CLDN18.2 靶向治疗方面具有全球意义的进展。我们强调了在靶点和治疗形式趋同、生物标志物定义、治疗窗口优化、生产一致性以及可供全球解读的证据生成方面持续存在的挑战，并讨论了人工智能如何能更高效地连接靶点发现、药物设计和临床试验优化。中国已成为肿瘤临床试验和治疗形式创新的主要来源，但仅靠规模并不能确保全球影响力。本综述将十年来实体瘤研发中的监管改革、特定疾病机遇、靶点生物学、治疗形式和证据质量联系起来，并界定了源自中国的项目产生可改变全球临床实践的证据所需的条件。参见 Shi 的相关文章，第 XX 页。

abstract: [JMIR cancer] Cervical cancer is the fourth most common cancer among women globally, with an estimated 660,000 new cases and 350,000 deaths in 2022. It imposes a disproportionate burden on underserved populations in low- and middle-income countries, where language barriers, cultural stigma, and limited access to health care hinder awareness and uptake of preventive measures. This study aimed to design, develop, and evaluate a multilingual AI-driven dialogue system for cervical cancer awareness, personalized risk assessment, and health care facility navigation, targeting underserved populations through a culturally adaptive and privacy-preserving digital health platform. A design science research framework guided the development of a 3-tier, cross-platform system comprising (1) a transparent, rule-based risk-stratification engine whose 30-item questionnaire mirrors the feature schema of the University of California, Irvine (UCI) Cervical Cancer Risk Factors dataset and whose weights encode established clinical risk factors drawn from World Health Organization, US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), and American Cancer Society guidance; (2) a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) chatbot powered by GPT-4o mini; and (3) a geospatial health care facility recommendation module. The system was implemented in TypeScript (NestJS) and Flutter (Google LLC) and deployed across Android, iOS, and web platforms with multilingual support for English, Spanish, Yoruba, and Swahili, of which English, Spanish, and Yoruba were included in the multilingual evaluation reported here. The risk engine was evaluated through clinical face-validity review of its factor weights; chatbot quality was assessed using retrieval precision, hallucination rate, large language model (LLM)-as-a-judge quality scoring, adversarial safety testing, and native-speaker rating of multilingual output. The rule-based engine produced deterministic, fully traceable risk levels (low, moderate, and high) with per-factor explanations for every completed assessment. The RAG chatbot achieved retrieval precision@3 of 0.88 and a 71.4% reduction in hallucination rate compared with a non-RAG baseline. Automated LLM-as-judge evaluation rated factual correctness at 4.3/5, and independent clinician review of 50 responses identified factual errors in 8% (4/50) of RAG-grounded outputs compared with 28% (14/50) for a non-RAG baseline (Cohen κ=0.84). The geospatial module achieved a specialty relevance precision of 0.87.
zh_abstract: [JMIR cancer] 宫颈癌是全球女性第四大常见癌症，2022年估计新发病例66万例，死亡35万例。它给低收入和中等收入国家中服务不足的人群带来了不成比例的负担，这些地区的语言障碍、文化污名以及医疗服务可及性有限，阻碍了人们对预防措施的认知和采纳。本研究旨在设计、开发并评估一个多语言AI驱动的对话系统，用于宫颈癌知识普及、个性化风险评估和医疗机构导航，通过一个具有文化适应性且保护隐私的数字健康平台面向服务不足的人群。研究以设计科学研究框架指导开发了一个三层、跨平台的系统，包括：（1）一个透明的、基于规则的风险分层引擎，其30项问卷与加州大学欧文分校（UCI）宫颈癌风险因素数据集的特征模式一致，其权重编码了来自世界卫生组织、美国疾病控制与预防中心（CDC）和美国癌症协会指南的既定临床风险因素；（2）一个由GPT-4o mini驱动的检索增强生成（RAG）聊天机器人；（3）一个地理空间医疗机构推荐模块。该系统采用TypeScript（NestJS）和Flutter（Google LLC）实现，部署于Android、iOS和网页平台，支持英语、西班牙语、约鲁巴语和斯瓦希里语，其中英语、西班牙语和约鲁巴语纳入了此处报告的多语言评估。风险引擎通过对其因素权重的临床表面效度审查进行评估；聊天机器人质量则通过检索精确率、幻觉率、大语言模型（LLM）作为评判者的质量评分、对抗性安全性测试以及母语者对多语言输出的评分进行评估。基于规则的引擎为每次完成的评估生成确定性的、完全可追溯的风险等级（低、中、高）及各因素的解释。RAG聊天机器人的检索precision@3为0.88，与非RAG基线相比幻觉率降低71.4%。LLM作为评判者的自动评估将事实正确性评为4.3/5；临床医生对50条回复的独立审查发现，RAG支撑的输出中有8%（4/50）存在事实错误，而非RAG基线为28%（14/50）（Cohen κ=0.84）。地理空间模块的专科相关性精确率为0.87。

abstract: [Cerebellum (London, England)] Characterizing cerebellar morphology is fundamental for accurately mapping its structure and function across individuals, yet remains challenging due to its densely foliated architecture. Although multiple automated segmentation pipelines exist, the measurement reproducibility of these tools has not been comprehensively benchmarked. We conducted a systematic assessment of reliability for cerebellar morphology estimates using four commonly used pipelines: one classic parcellation method (CERES), two deep-learning methods (ACAPULCO, DeepCERES), and one voxel-based morphometry toolbox (SUIT). Leveraging the HNU dataset, which provides MRI scans for ten timepoints per individual over a month, we evaluated the test-retest reliability for each of the four pipelines using ReX, an integrative tool for quantifying and optimizing measurement reliability and individual differences. We quantified intra- and inter-individual variability, as well as the Intraclass Correlation Coefficient (ICC), for each pipeline at both global and region-of-interest levels. We used two pools of data: a common dataset of 12 subjects x 5 sessions to benchmark all the pipelines, and method-specific datasets including pools of subjects with 5 valid sessions for each pipeline to assess the generalizability of our findings. Overall, all pipelines yielded highly reliable segmentation volumes (ICC > 0.87). DeepCERES demonstrated the most consistent performance across all metrics and subject pools, while SUIT achieved the highest ICC on the common dataset but showed decreased reliability when evaluated on a larger subject pool. Importantly, our analysis highlighted substantial heterogeneity in reliability across lobules for each method. Lobule X consistently showed reduced reliability whereas lobules I-V, VI, Crus I, IX, and VIIIB were reliably estimated across all pipelines. While all pipelines demonstrated strong reliability, DeepCERES showed the most robust and consistent performance overall. Substantial lobule-specific variability and method-dependent failure rates underscore the need for reliability-aware pipeline selection to optimize cerebellar morphology estimation in research.
zh_abstract: [Cerebellum (London, England)] 刻画小脑形态对于准确描绘个体间小脑的结构与功能至关重要，但由于其叶片密集折叠的结构，这仍具挑战性。尽管已有多种自动分割流程，这些工具测量的可重复性尚未得到全面的基准评估。我们使用四种常用流程对小脑形态估计的可靠性进行了系统评估：一种经典分区方法（CERES）、两种深度学习方法（ACAPULCO、DeepCERES）以及一种基于体素的形态测量工具箱（SUIT）。利用 HNU 数据集（提供每位个体在一个月内十个时间点的 MRI 扫描），我们使用 ReX（一种用于量化和优化测量可靠性及个体差异的综合工具）评估了四种流程各自的重测信度。我们在全局和感兴趣区水平上，量化了每种流程的个体内和个体间变异性以及组内相关系数（ICC）。我们使用了两个数据池：一个用于对所有流程进行基准比较的公共数据集（12 名受试者 × 5 次扫描），以及包含每种流程具有 5 次有效扫描的受试者池的方法特异性数据集，用以评估我们发现的可推广性。总体而言，所有流程都得到了高度可靠的分割体积（ICC > 0.87）。DeepCERES 在所有指标和受试者池中表现最为一致，而 SUIT 在公共数据集上取得最高 ICC，但在更大的受试者池中评估时可靠性下降。重要的是，我们的分析突显了每种方法在不同小叶之间可靠性的显著异质性。X 小叶的可靠性始终较低，而 I-V、VI、Crus I、IX 和 VIIIB 小叶在所有流程中均被可靠地估计。尽管所有流程都表现出较强的可靠性，DeepCERES 总体上表现出最稳健且一致的性能。显著的小叶特异性变异以及方法依赖的失败率，凸显了在研究中为优化小脑形态估计而选择兼顾可靠性的流程的必要性。

abstract: [European journal of radiology] Upper airway (UA) compromise is a significant and potentially life-threatening complication of acute neck infection (ANI), but objective, quantitative imaging features are lacking. This study aimed to evaluate the association between UA morphometry in emergency neck MRI and disease severity in ANI, and to develop and evaluate a deep learning (DL)-based model for automatic UA segmentation in ANI patients. A total of 322 patients were included. UA lumen was manually segmented, and prespecified morphometric features were extracted. UA morphometry was correlated with clinical outcomes. Interobserver agreement for all extracted features was evaluated with the Intraclass Correlation Coefficient (ICC). An nnU-Net model was trained on manually segmented data, and its performance was evaluated using the Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC) and feature-specific ICCs. ICU admission occurred in 33/322 patients (10.2 %) and prolonged stay (>5 days) in 47/319 (14.7 %). Minimum cross-sectional area, compactness, maximum midline shift, and length of airway narrowing were associated with ICU admission (false-discovery-rate q ≤ 0.008) but not with prolonged stay, and did not significantly improve an established clinical model (AUC 0.80 to 0.84, DeLong p = 0.07 to 0.12). Interobserver agreement was moderate-to-excellent. The nnU-Net reached a median DSC of 0.920 with ICCs of 0.853 to 0.973 and reproduced the ICU associations. Quantitative UA morphometry in ANI is reproducible. A narrow caliber, a long narrowed segment, and lateral displacement of the airway are associated with ICU admission, without demonstrated incremental value over established predictors in the prespecified comparison. nnU-Net segmentation reproduces the features and their univariable associations.

title: MotionDecipher: LLM-Assisted Clinical Interpretation of Human Motion Signals for Efficient Gait Analysis

abstract: Clinical gait and motion analysis is widely used to guide targeted interventions for patients with neurological disorders, the outcome of which is typically a report with descriptions of joint movements and forces. Current practices rely on experts' manual effort, which is labor-intensive and time-consuming. Recent advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) provide opportunities to address this problem, but translating human motion into clinical gait descriptions remains challenging because the quality of the context directly affects LLMs' reasoning capability over continuous motion signals. To tackle this, we introduce MotionDecipher, a novel framework bridging the semantic gap between motion data and clinical interpretations. Specifically, we made 3 key advancements: 1) a Human Motion Tokenizer that converts motion signals into domain-specific tokens for time- and frequency-informed gait interpretation; 2) a Meta Feature Selector that transforms tokens into Structured Representations; and 3) a Hybrid Context Constructor to determine the optimal demonstration-based prompt for In-Context Learning. We evaluated MotionDecipher on data collected at an accredited gait lab from 122 patients and 46 controls. Results show that MotionDecipher achieves 0.91 BERTScore (13% over GPT-5), while expert evaluation ranks MotionDecipher highest in Correctness, Completeness, and Conciseness compared to baselines, highlighting its promise for efficient gait analysis.
zh_abstract: 临床步态与运动分析被广泛用于指导神经系统疾病患者的针对性干预，其结果通常是一份描述关节运动和受力的报告。目前的做法依赖专家的人工操作，费时费力。大语言模型（LLMs）的最新进展为解决这一问题提供了机会，但将人体运动转化为临床步态描述仍具挑战，因为上下文的质量会直接影响 LLMs 对连续运动信号的推理能力。为此，我们提出 MotionDecipher，这是一个弥合运动数据与临床解读之间语义鸿沟的新框架。具体而言，我们取得了3项关键进展：1）人体运动分词器（Human Motion Tokenizer），将运动信号转换为特定领域的词元（token），用于结合时间与频率信息的步态解读；2）元特征选择器（Meta Feature Selector），将词元转换为结构化表示；3）混合上下文构建器（Hybrid Context Constructor），用于确定上下文学习（In-Context Learning）中基于示例的最优提示。我们在一家认证步态实验室采集的122例患者和46名对照者的数据上评估了 MotionDecipher。结果显示，MotionDecipher 的 BERTScore 达到0.91（比 GPT-5 高13%），同时专家评价显示，与基线方法相比，MotionDecipher 在正确性、完整性和简洁性方面排名最高，显示了其在高效步态分析中的应用前景。

title: GenStrain: Multi-Conditional Generative Diffusion Model To Synthesize High-quality Motion and Strain Maps From Cardiac Magnetic Resonance Images

abstract: This paper presents GenStrain, a novel method for synthesizing high-quality cardiac motion-based strain maps from routinely collected cine cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) images. Existing approaches typically rely on image registration to estimate motion (a sequence of displacements) from cine CMR images, but cine CMR presents very sparse trackable intramyocardial features, presenting challenges to estimate intramyocardial motion. An advanced imaging technique, Displacement Encoding with Stimulated Echoes (DENSE) CMR, is considered as the gold standard for strain assessment, but it requires additional acquisitions, which are not ideal for efficient clinical workflows. To address this gap, we introduce GenStrain, a novel framework designed to learn the data distribution of highly accurate cardiac motion captured by DENSE. In particular, we develop a diffusion process in motion space, where spatiotemporal continuity is carefully considered. To fully leverage both cine CMR images and their associated motion patterns, we introduce a multi-conditional conditioning strategy that integrates anatomical features and motion representations learned by a spatiotemporal registration model to guide the generation process. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed model, GenStrain, outperforms existing strain analysis methods based on displacement estimates from both traditional registration approaches and state-of-the-art (SOTA) deep learning models. Our model represents a promising step toward more accurate cardiac function assessment and holds great potential for clinical translation. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Rishov-MIA/GenStrain.
zh_abstract: 本文提出 GenStrain，一种从常规采集的电影心脏磁共振（CMR）图像合成高质量、基于心脏运动的应变图的新方法。现有方法通常依赖图像配准，从电影 CMR 图像中估计运动（位移序列），但电影 CMR 中可追踪的心肌内特征非常稀疏，给心肌内运动的估计带来挑战。一种先进的成像技术——刺激回波位移编码（DENSE）CMR——被视为应变评估的金标准，但它需要额外的采集，不利于高效的临床工作流程。为填补这一空白，我们提出 GenStrain，这是一种新颖的框架，旨在学习由 DENSE 捕获的高精度心脏运动的数据分布。具体而言，我们在运动空间中构建了一个扩散过程，并充分考虑了时空连续性。为充分利用电影 CMR 图像及其相关的运动模式，我们引入了一种多条件调控策略，将解剖特征与由时空配准模型学习到的运动表征相结合，以引导生成过程。实验结果表明，我们提出的 GenStrain 模型优于现有基于传统配准方法和最先进（SOTA）深度学习模型位移估计的应变分析方法。我们的模型是迈向更准确心脏功能评估的有前景的一步，并具有很大的临床转化潜力。我们的代码已公开：https://github.com/Rishov-MIA/GenStrain。

title: RapidMitDet: Boosting Computational Efficiency for Mitosis Detection via Magnification Alignment

summary: 提出由粗到细的有丝分裂检测框架，先在低倍率识别候选，再在高倍率确认，并用放大倍率对齐的知识蒸馏降低低倍率模型性能损失。

abstract: Automated mitosis detection is a critical research focus, enabling pathologists to rapidly assess mitotic indices for tumor malignancy evaluation. However, most of the existing detection approaches suffer from significant computational inefficiency due to the giga-pixel image resolution of Whole-Slide Images (WSIs), which greatly hinders their clinical applicability. In this study, we propose RapidMitDet, a computational efficient mitosis detection approach. Our method employs a coarse-to-fine framework, first identifying mitotic candidates at lower magnification and then confirming them at higher magnification. In the coarse-detection stage, we introduce magnification-aligned knowledge distillation to reduce the information gap between magnification levels while minimizing the performance degradation in the lower magnification detection model. In the subsequent fine-classification stage, we propose adaptive triplet learning (ATL) to optimize infomative sample selection, thereby enhancing discrimination between mitotic and non-mitotic instances. Experimental results show that RapidMitDet achieves the optimal accuracy-efficiency balance at 20x magnification, improving computational speed by up to 5.62 times over the latest state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods. Due to its lightweight model design, RapidMitDet can also deliver efficient detection at higher magnification (40x) while achieving even higher detection performance. In WSI-level evaluations, our method shows strong agreement with pathologists' diagnoses (ICCs: 0.879 (40x), 0.822 (20x)) while maintaining superior efficiency, highlighting its potential for clinical application. Code is available at https://github.com/logincat/RapidMitDet
zh_abstract: 自动有丝分裂检测是一个关键的研究重点，可使病理医生快速评估有丝分裂指数以评价肿瘤恶性程度。然而，由于全切片图像（WSI）具有十亿像素级的分辨率，大多数现有检测方法存在显著的计算低效问题，这极大地妨碍了其临床应用。在本研究中，我们提出 RapidMitDet，一种计算高效的有丝分裂检测方法。我们的方法采用由粗到细的框架，先在较低放大倍数下识别有丝分裂候选对象，再在较高放大倍数下加以确认。在粗检测阶段，我们引入放大倍数对齐的知识蒸馏，以缩小不同放大倍数之间的信息差距，同时尽量减少低倍检测模型的性能下降。在随后的精细分类阶段，我们提出自适应三元组学习（ATL）以优化信息丰富样本的选择，从而增强有丝分裂与非有丝分裂实例之间的区分能力。实验结果表明，RapidMitDet 在 20 倍放大下实现了最优的精度-效率平衡，相比最新的最先进（SOTA）方法，计算速度最高提升 5.62 倍。得益于其轻量化的模型设计，RapidMitDet 在更高放大倍数（40 倍）下也能实现高效检测，并取得更高的检测性能。在 WSI 水平的评估中，我们的方法与病理医生的诊断显示出高度一致性（ICC：0.879（40 倍），0.822（20 倍）），同时保持了卓越的效率，凸显了其临床应用潜力。代码见 https://github.com/logincat/RapidMitDet

title: Volumetric Latent Diffusion for Brain Tumour Segmentation with Missing Modalities

abstract: Brain tumour segmentation from magnetic resonance imaging normally assumes that all four imaging sequences are available, but in clinical practice one or more are frequently missing. Existing methods for incomplete inputs learn modality-invariant representations or distil from a full-modality teacher, and return a single deterministic mask. Gen- erative formulations instead model a distribution over plausible masks, but the cost of sampling at full resolution has largely confined them to two dimensions. This paper proposes a three-dimensional conditional latent diffusion framework for whole-tumour segmentation from incom- plete multi-sequence MRI. Images and annotations are first compressed by two volumetric autoencoders, which makes diffusion over whole vol- umes affordable, and sequences are dropped at random during training so that a single model handles every combination of missing sequences. Because the model samples rather than predicts, repeated draws also yield a voxel-wise map of disagreement at no extra training cost. Evalu- ations on 2,601 studies from BraTS 2023 and 2024 show that the method reaches 0.955 Dice with all four sequences and 0.904 with FLAIR alone, and that it is the most accurate of the four methods compared in eight of the fifteen configurations. The disagreement between draws widens as sequences are withheld, giving a signal that accompanies the prediction rather than replacing it
zh_abstract: 基于磁共振成像的脑肿瘤分割通常假定四种成像序列均可获得，但在临床实践中常常缺失一种或多种序列。现有针对不完整输入的方法学习模态不变表征或从全模态教师模型进行蒸馏，并给出单一的确定性掩膜。生成式方法则对可能掩膜的分布进行建模，但在全分辨率下采样的成本使其在很大程度上局限于二维。本文提出一种三维条件潜在扩散框架，用于从不完整的多序列 MRI 中进行全肿瘤分割。图像和标注首先由两个体积自编码器进行压缩，使得对整个体积进行扩散在计算上可承受；训练期间随机丢弃序列，使单一模型能够处理所有序列缺失的组合。由于该模型是采样而非预测，重复采样还能在无需额外训练成本的情况下得到体素级的不一致图。在来自 BraTS 2023 和 2024 的 2,601 项研究上的评估表明，该方法在四个序列齐全时达到 0.955 的 Dice，仅用 FLAIR 时达到 0.904，并且在十五种配置中的八种里是所比较的四种方法中最准确的。随着序列被舍弃，各次采样之间的不一致性增大，从而提供了一个伴随预测结果而非取代预测结果的信号。

title: SideAge-RiskNet: Predicted Mammographic-Age Features for Future Breast Cancer Risk and Laterality Prediction

abstract: Whether breast-specific mammographic aging provides information beyond chronological age for future cancer prediction remains unclear. We propose SideAge-RiskNet, a framework integrating predicted mammographic-age features with breast-specific representations for multi-year breast cancer risk and conditional laterality prediction. A side-aware DenseNet121 trained on never-cancer reference examinations estimates left and right breast ages. Age-adjusted residuals and bilateral age descriptors are subsequently fused with corresponding image representations, while clinical variables contribute through an image--clinical risk branch. The framework jointly predicts cumulative cancer risk over 1--5 years and the subsequently affected breast among unilateral cancer cases. Across 4,480 EMBED and 248 external examinations, pre-cancer scans demonstrated pronounced bilateral age asymmetry. SideAge-RiskNet established state-of-the-art performance in 1--5-year risk assessment over Mirai and AsymMirai with mean risk AUROCs of 81.73% on EMBED and 72.83% on CSMC. Furthermore, it enabled conditional cancer laterality prediction, achieving AUROCs of 73.26% and 82.53%, respectively. This demonstrates the critical utility of bilateral aging phenotypes in localized breast cancer risk surveillance.

abstract: [Magnetic resonance imaging] To evaluate integrated deep learning reconstruction (Integrated DLR), which combines phase correction, denoising, and super-resolution, for prostate diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) by comparing it with compressed sensing (CS) and deep learning-based denoising reconstruction (Denoising DLR). This single-center, retrospective study included 47 patients scanned on a single-vendor 3-T system. Three DWI datasets were reconstructed from identical raw data using CS, Denoising DLR, and Integrated DLR. Two radiologists rated overall image quality, noise, artifact, and prostate delineation. Apparent signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) was assessed in all patients. In 21 patients with pathologically confirmed prostate cancer, we assessed lesion conspicuity, lesion localization/anatomical relationship, Prostate Imaging Reporting and Data System (PI-RADS) version 2.1 DWI scores, apparent lesion contrast-to-noise ratio (CNR), and apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC). Comparisons were performed using Friedman tests followed by Bonferroni-corrected Wilcoxon signed-rank tests. Scores for overall image quality, noise, and prostate delineation were highest with Integrated DLR, followed by Denoising DLR and CS, for both readers (all p < 0.001); apparent SNR showed the same pattern (p < 0.001). Artifact scores did not differ among methods. Lesion conspicuity differed among methods for Reader 2 (p = 0.044) but not for Reader 1 (p = 0.199), whereas Integrated DLR yielded the highest lesion localization/anatomical relationship scores for both readers (both p < 0.001). Integrated DLR also yielded the highest apparent CNR and lesion ADC (both p < 0.001), while PI-RADS DWI scores were unchanged. Integrated DLR improved prostate DWI image quality and lesion visibility compared with CS and Denoising DLR, potentially facilitating visual assessment of prostate DWI.

abstract: [Physics and imaging in radiation oncology] Background and purpose: Artificial intelligence is increasingly integrated into radiotherapy workflows, yet it remains vulnerable to out-of-distribution image data that can introduce unexpected behavior in clinical tasks. Deep learning (DL)-based anomaly detection for pelvic magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) remains limited and transparent evaluation for full automation is lacking. This study aimed to develop two self-supervised anomaly-detection framework variations in radiotherapy for pelvic and brain MRI. Materials and methods: A two-stage self-supervised DL-framework was trained separately for pelvic and brain MRI utilizing three public datasets. The first stage compressed normal image data into discrete representations, and a second stage modeled the representation distribution. Anomaly-evidence was obtained by combining perceptual image differences with token-surprisal scores via negative log-likelihood estimation. Automated detection was evaluated for two anatomical cohorts: pelvis, encompassing both synthetic global anomalies and real clinical anomalies, and brain, comprising clinically annotated anomalies. Performance was assessed using sensitivity, specificity, and area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC). For each cohort, a subset of normal images was reserved for analysis. Results: Promising exploratory performance across evaluation cohorts was obtained. AUCs were 0.97 (95% CI 0.96-0.99) for synthetic pelvic anomalies, 0.95 (95% CI 0.90-1.00) for clinical pelvic anomalies, and 0.81 (95% CI 0.74-0.87) for brain anomalies. Qualitative heatmap analysis showed spatial agreement between detected anomalies and reference annotations. Conclusions: The framework variations showed promising anomaly detection performance across pelvic and brain MRI, supporting its potential for automated MRI quality control in radiotherapy. Heatmap-based visualization further improved interpretability by spatially localizing detected anomalies.
zh_abstract: [放射肿瘤学中的物理学与影像学] 【背景与目的】人工智能日益融入放疗工作流程，但其仍易受分布外图像数据的影响，这可能在临床任务中引入意外行为。基于深度学习（DL）的盆腔磁共振成像（MRI）异常检测仍然有限，且缺乏针对完全自动化的透明评估。本研究旨在为放疗中的盆腔和脑部MRI开发两种自监督异常检测框架变体。【材料与方法】利用三个公共数据集，分别针对盆腔和脑部MRI训练了两阶段自监督DL框架。第一阶段将正常图像数据压缩为离散表示，第二阶段对该表示的分布进行建模。通过负对数似然估计，将感知图像差异与token惊异度（token-surprisal）评分相结合，获得异常证据。对两个解剖队列评估了自动检测：盆腔队列（包含合成的全局异常和真实临床异常）和脑部队列（包含经临床标注的异常）。使用敏感度、特异度和受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）评估性能。对每个队列，保留了一部分正常图像用于分析。【结果】各评估队列均获得了有前景的探索性性能。合成盆腔异常的AUC为0.97（95% CI 0.96-0.99），临床盆腔异常为0.95（95% CI 0.90-1.00），脑部异常为0.81（95% CI 0.74-0.87）。定性热图分析显示检测到的异常与参考标注在空间上一致。【结论】该框架变体在盆腔和脑部MRI中均表现出有前景的异常检测性能，支持其用于放疗中自动化MRI质量控制的潜力。基于热图的可视化通过对检测到的异常进行空间定位，进一步提高了可解释性。

abstract: [Journal of thoracic disease] Radiotherapy is a key component in the management of esophageal cancer (EC). Artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a transformative tool for optimizing radiotherapy workflows. Numerous AI-based tools are being developed to improve efficiency and facilitate the personalization of radiation oncology. This study aimed to provide an up-to-date review of the literature on recent advances in AI applications across the EC radiotherapy workflow. The PubMed, Embase, and Web of Science databases were searched to retrieve original English-language articles published from January 1, 2020 to May 26, 2026. The following search terms were used: "Esophageal neoplasms", "esophageal cancer", "oesophageal cancer" AND "artificial intelligence", "AI" AND "radiation oncology", "radiotherapy", "radiation", "chemoradiotherapy". The included studies covered different steps in the radiotherapy workflow; that is, initial treatment decision-making, treatment planning and preparation, treatment delivery, and post-treatment follow-up. A total of 105 studies covering the different stages of the radiotherapy workflow were included in the review. Most studies focused on initial treatment decision-making, primarily benefit-risk stratification through predictive modeling of treatment outcomes and treatment-related toxicities, followed by treatment planning and preparation, particularly automated segmentation and treatment planning. Conversely, few studies investigated AI applications in treatment plan approval and quality assurance, or treatment delivery. Notably, most of the included studies were retrospective, with substantial heterogeneity in study designs, methodologies, and reporting. AI demonstrates substantial potential to facilitate clinical decision-making while improving the efficiency and accuracy of radiotherapy workflows. Future research should prioritize multicenter prospective studies, standardized methodological and reporting frameworks, and explainable AI (XAI) to improve the reliability, transparency, and clinical translation of AI models.
zh_abstract: [胸部疾病杂志] 放疗是食管癌（EC）治疗的关键组成部分。人工智能（AI）已成为优化放疗工作流程的变革性工具。目前正在开发大量基于AI的工具，以提高效率并促进放射肿瘤学的个体化。本研究旨在对近期AI在EC放疗工作流程各环节中应用进展的文献进行最新综述。检索了PubMed、Embase和Web of Science数据库，以获取2020年1月1日至2026年5月26日发表的英文原始文章。所用检索词如下：“Esophageal neoplasms”“esophageal cancer”“oesophageal cancer”，并与“artificial intelligence”“AI”以及“radiation oncology”“radiotherapy”“radiation”“chemoradiotherapy”组合。纳入的研究涵盖放疗工作流程的不同步骤，即初始治疗决策、治疗计划制定与准备、治疗实施以及治疗后随访。本综述共纳入105项涵盖放疗工作流程不同阶段的研究。多数研究聚焦于初始治疗决策，主要是通过对治疗结局和治疗相关毒性进行预测建模来进行获益-风险分层，其次是治疗计划制定与准备，尤其是自动勾画和治疗计划制定。相反，很少有研究探讨AI在治疗计划审批与质量保证或治疗实施中的应用。值得注意的是，纳入的研究大多为回顾性研究，在研究设计、方法学和报告方面存在显著异质性。AI在促进临床决策的同时，在提高放疗工作流程的效率和准确性方面展现出巨大潜力。未来研究应优先开展多中心前瞻性研究、建立标准化的方法学和报告框架，并发展可解释AI（XAI），以提高AI模型的可靠性、透明度和临床转化。

abstract: [Frontiers in medicine] Ventilator associated pneumonia (VAP) is a major complication in the intensive care unit (ICU) and requires objective computed tomography (CT) evaluation. Therefore, this article conducted a retrospective research analysis and developed a multimodal deep learning framework. Firstly, this retrospective study included 512 patients clinically diagnosed with VAP, and then utilized a developed multimodal deep learning framework for voxel-level lesion segmentation, multi-label radiological discovery classification, and radiological burden grading. This framework integrates the anatomical priors of TotalSegmenter, a three-dimensional (3D) Swin UNETR multitasking network, and cross attention fusion of CT features and ventilation parameters. Ultimately, the study showed that the Dice score for internal validation was 0.847, the macroscopic mean area (AUC) under the subject's working characteristic curve was 0.919, and the weighted kappa was 0.826. External validation showed a Dice score of 0.821, with no significant difference between scanner manufacturers. After adjusting for clinical covariates, including acute physiology and chronic health assessment II (APACHE II) scores, there was still a significant correlation between radiation load level and 28 day mortality (hazard ratio [HR] = 2.34, P < 0.001), supporting its potential prognostic relevance.

abstract: [Journal of bone oncology] Multimodal imaging is central to the diagnosis, staging, and management of bone tumors. Radiography and computed tomography remain essential for initial assessment and cortical evaluation, magnetic resonance imaging provides superior soft tissue contrast and local staging accuracy, and positron emission tomography enhances detection of metastatic disease and treatment response. No single technique suffices across clinical scenarios. Advances in artificial intelligence and radiomics offer avenues to augment this framework, with demonstrated potential in lesion classification, segmentation, prognostication, and response prediction. This review advances a specific argument rather than surveying available technologies: that the principal constraint on artificial intelligence in musculoskeletal oncology is the stability of the reference standard rather than algorithmic capability. Ground truth in bone tumors is unstable on four grounds. Core needle biopsy samples a limited volume and may miss the highest-grade component: agreement between biopsy and resection grade in central chondrosarcoma falls from a weighted kappa of 0.63 in long bones to 0.12 in the pelvis. Expert interpretation is itself inconsistent, with interobserver kappa for grading cartilaginous tumors of 0.44 among musculoskeletal pathologists and 0.35 among radiologists. Molecular criteria have redefined entities within the past decade, so older datasets contain classes that no longer exist as defined. And histological classification does not reliably predict clinical behavior. Consequently, measurable accuracy has a ceiling set by the reference standard rather than the algorithm, and apparent failure on external validation may reflect label divergence between institutions rather than model deficiency. Evidence is graded throughout, and clinical readiness distinguished from technical performance. No system for primary bone tumor characterization has regulatory clearance in the United States or Europe, and formal appraisal of this literature confirms low methodological compliance and infrequent external validation. Progress will depend on multicenter validation and protocol harmonization, and, distinctively for this field, on composite reference standards, outcome-based endpoints, and explicit uncertainty modelling, since ground-truth instability can be mitigated but not eliminated.
zh_abstract: [Journal of bone oncology] 多模态影像对骨肿瘤的诊断、分期和管理至关重要。X线摄影和计算机断层扫描仍是初始评估和皮质评估所必需的，磁共振成像具有更优的软组织对比度和局部分期准确性，正电子发射断层扫描则可增强对转移性疾病和治疗反应的检测。没有任何单一技术能够适用于所有临床情形。人工智能和影像组学的进展为完善这一框架提供了途径，在病变分类、分割、预后判断和疗效预测方面已显示出潜力。本综述提出的是一个具体论点，而非对现有技术的全面综述：即肌肉骨骼肿瘤学中人工智能的主要制约因素是参考标准的稳定性，而非算法能力。骨肿瘤的金标准在四个方面是不稳定的。粗针穿刺活检取样体积有限，可能遗漏最高级别的成分：在中央型软骨肉瘤中，活检与切除标本分级的一致性（加权kappa）从长骨的0.63降至骨盆的0.12。专家判读本身也不一致，软骨肿瘤分级的观察者间kappa在肌肉骨骼病理医师中为0.44，在放射科医师中为0.35。分子学标准在过去十年中重新定义了多种疾病实体，因此较早的数据集包含的类别已不再符合现有定义。并且组织学分类不能可靠地预测临床行为。因此，可测量的准确性存在由参考标准而非算法所设定的上限，外部验证中表现出的失败可能反映的是各机构间标签的差异，而非模型缺陷。全文对证据进行了分级，并将临床就绪度与技术性能区分开来。目前在美国或欧洲，尚无用于原发性骨肿瘤特征判定的系统获得监管批准，对该文献的正式评价也证实其方法学依从性较低，外部验证较少。进展将取决于多中心验证和方案协调，并且就该领域而言，尤其取决于复合参考标准、基于结局的终点和明确的不确定性建模，因为金标准的不稳定性可以减轻但无法消除。

abstract: [Work (Reading, Mass.)] BackgroundOccupational therapists working in cognitive rehabilitation may face high cognitive demands, and professional isolation. Although AI is used for information retrieval and decision support, its role in supporting reflective clinical reasoning remains insufficiently conceptualized. As scholarly attention shifts from automation toward augmentation of professional judgment, the next step is to understand how AI may support reflective reasoning in complex rehabilitation work.ObjectiveTo examine key challenges in cognitive rehabilitation and explore how these needs may inform a conceptual design for GenAI-mediated mentoring within clinical work.MethodsA qualitative study grounded in Design Thinking methodology was conducted with 30 female occupational therapists (age range 24-64 years, M = 41.26, SD = 10.35) with wide range of clinical experience (less than one year to more than 20 years) from diverse settings. They completed a demographic questionnaire and participated in two Design Thinking workshops (n = 14; n = 16). Seven participants subsequently engaged in follow-up interviews to refine design implications. All sessions were audio-recorded, transcribed, and analyzed thematically.ResultsThe thematic analysis yielded four themes: (A) The Therapist's role (B) Challenging therapist-client interactions, (C) Loneliness of the Therapist (D) Expectations for guidance or support aspects. These findings informed the conceptualization of a GenAI mentoring framework grounded in real-world clinical demands.ConclusionsThe findings support the design of generative AI systems as dialogic, context-sensitive tools intended to strengthen professional judgment, warranting further examination of their integration within real-world clinical workflows.

abstract: Background: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly used to accelerate systematic reviews that inform clinical practice and policy. However, evidence on the methodological adherence, reporting completeness, and risk of bias of completed AI-assisted reviews is limited. Objective: To compare methodological adherence, reporting completeness, and risk of bias between published systematic reviews with reported AI assistance and matched reviews with no reported AI use, and to assess AI-use transparency. Methods: We conducted a matched-cohort meta-research study of English-language, peer-reviewed health systematic reviews. AI-assisted reviews published during 2023--2025 were matched 1:2 to reviews with no reported AI use using individualized MEDLINE searches targeting publication timing, clinical domain, review type, and meta-analysis status. When more than two eligible comparators were available, two were randomly selected. AI assistance was defined as reported use during searching, screening, data extraction, risk-of-bias assessment, evidence synthesis, or substantive drafting. Full texts and supplementary materials were examined to classify reported AI use. The primary outcome was a prespecified modified 13-item AMSTAR-2 methodological-adherence score (range 0 -- 13; noninferiority margin &-1 point). Secondary outcomes included PRISMA 2020 reporting completeness and ROBIS risk of bias; AI-use transparency was assessed descriptively. Adapted 13-item AMSTAR-2 confidence categories were summarized descriptively, while critical- and noncritical-domain adherence was examined in exploratory adjusted analyses. Multivariable regression models adjusted for journal impact tier, funding reporting, formal review-group affiliation, review-team size, and review-question type, using cluster-robust standard errors by matched set. Sensitivity analyses included matched-set fixed-effects models. The study was registered on the Open Science Framework (DOI: 10.17605/OSF.IO/Q5JRW). abstract: Predicting protein melting temperature (Tm) and organismal optimal growth temperature (OGT) is essential for enzyme engineering, biocatalyst design, and metagenomic bioprospecting, yet computational prediction faces several fundamental bottlenecks: sequence-only representations miss tertiary packing; dual-task coupling induces destructive gradient conflict; natural database skew (>87% mesophiles) drives mesophilic collapse; and existing tools produce uncalibrated point predictions. To address these challenges, we present StableProt, a structure-aware framework that couples amino acid sequences with Foldseek 3Di structural tokens via a frozen SaProt backbone to capture 3D contacts. Disjoint heads condition thermodynamic stability on ecological context without gradient conflict, while targeted 14% mesophilic subsampling expands thermophile representation to eliminate mesophilic collapse. Calibrated ensemble modeling reduces calibration error to 1.92%, providing dependable 95% confidence intervals. Evaluating models across 10{degrees}C temperature intervals reveals severe baseline collapse at thermal extremes, whereas StableProt maintains robust accuracy across regimes. On ProThermDB and zero-shot FireProtDB, StableProt achieves state-of-the-art probabilistic accuracy (CRPS = 4.52{degrees}C and 8.71{degrees}C) while recovering 92.0% of hyperthermophiles ([≥]80{degrees}C), and in prospective validation, its calibrated intervals capture both enzyme stability (75.3% coverage) and host environmental growth temperatures (78.1% coverage). StableProt is freely accessible as an interactive web server at https://stableprot.dixitlab.org/.

abstract: [Quantitative imaging in medicine and surgery] Acute radiation dermatitis (ARD) is a common toxicity of breast cancer radiotherapy that affects quality of life. Artificial intelligence (AI)-based models have been increasingly developed to predict ARD, but their methodological quality and clinical readiness remain unclear. This study aimed to systematically evaluate AI-based prediction models for ARD. A systematic search of PubMed, Embase (Ovid), Web of Science, and MEDLINE (Ovid) was conducted for studies published up to December 1, 2025. Studies were eligible if they developed and/or validated AI-based models for predicting ARD in patients with breast cancer receiving radiotherapy. Data were extracted using the CHARMS framework. Model quality, applicability, and risk of bias were assessed using the Prediction Model Risk of Bias Assessment Tool plus Artificial Intelligence (PROBAST + AI) tool. Given the substantial heterogeneity among studies, a qualitative synthesis was performed. Nineteen studies involving 8,506 patients were included, with sample sizes ranging from 20 to 2,058. Most studies were single-center (16/19), and only three were multicenter. Validation area under the curve (AUC) values ranged from 0.66 to 0.99. The models incorporated clinical, dosimetric, radiomics, and/or dosiomics features, with 5-154 predictors in the final models. Calibration and decision curve analysis were rarely reported, and no study performed external validation. Most studies had a high or unclear risk of bias according to PROBAST + AI, mainly related to small sample sizes, incomplete reporting, and lack of external validation. Although current AI-based models for predicting ARD in breast cancer radiotherapy demonstrate promising discriminatory performance, their methodological limitations and lack of external validation limit their readiness for routine clinical implementation. Future studies with more rigorous designs, standardized outcome assessment, transparent reporting, and independent external validation are required to facilitate clinical translation.

abstract: Segmentation masks are increasingly reviewed rather than redrawn, which requires knowing where a mask is likely wrong. Learned error maps rank pixels by risk, but the number of pixels to warn is chosen ad hoc, and calibrating one warning threshold over all error pixels may leave errors far from the predicted contour under-flagged. We propose RACE-Triage, a post-hoc error triage framework that leaves the segmentation mask unchanged. A risk network is trained on out-of-fold predictions from backbone-independent inputs. The predicted contour partitions each image into a boundary band and a non-boundary region, and conformal risk control is applied separately in each region to bound the expected fraction of missed errors among cases with errors there. On ISIC 2018 dermoscopy and BUSI breast ultrasound (where patient identifiers are unavailable, so independence across images is assumed), pooled control met its overall target but missed on average 31.8% and 36.4% of non-boundary errors. Regional control reduced these fractions to 19.3% and 20.9% and raised the recall of size-filtered false-negative components from 0.722 to 0.818 and from 0.611 to 0.763. The mean warned area grew by 1.6 and 4.9 percentage points, and its 95th percentile reached 23.5% and 38.5%. The effect held across three seeds and a second backbone, and area-matched heuristics did not reproduce it. On the external PH$^2$ set, frozen thresholds exceeded both targets, whereas recalibration with 100 local images brought the mean over repeated splits below them. Regional calibration improves non-boundary error coverage at a measured increase in warned area.
zh_abstract: 分割掩膜越来越多地是被审阅而非重新绘制，这就需要知道掩膜在哪些位置可能出错。习得的错误图按风险对像素排序，但需要警示的像素数量是临时选定的；而且对所有错误像素校准单一警示阈值，可能使远离预测轮廓的错误被警示不足。我们提出 RACE-Triage，一种不改变分割掩膜的事后错误分诊框架。风险网络在与骨干网络无关的输入的折外（out-of-fold）预测上训练。预测轮廓将每幅图像划分为边界带和非边界区域，并在各区域分别应用保形风险控制（conformal risk control），以约束在该区域存在错误的病例中漏检错误的期望比例。在 ISIC 2018 皮肤镜和 BUSI 乳腺超声数据集上（因无法获得患者标识符，故假定图像间相互独立），合并控制达到了总体目标，但平均漏检了 31.8% 和 36.4% 的非边界错误。分区域控制将这些比例降至 19.3% 和 20.9%，并将经大小过滤的假阴性连通分量的召回率分别从 0.722 提高到 0.818、从 0.611 提高到 0.763。平均警示面积分别增加 1.6 和 4.9 个百分点，其第 95 百分位数分别达到 23.5% 和 38.5%。该效应在三个随机种子和第二种骨干网络上均成立，面积匹配的启发式方法无法复现该效应。在外部 PH$^2$ 数据集上，冻结阈值超出了两个目标；而使用 100 张本地图像重新校准后，重复划分的均值低于两个目标。分区域校准以可测量的警示面积增加为代价，改善了非边界错误的覆盖。
